caption: The drawing features a single object, a lidded vessel with two handles, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The vessel is depicted in shades of gray with precise, dark outlines and shading to indicate form and reflective surfaces, suggesting it is made of metal. The body of the vessel is rounded with vertical fluted patterns along its sides and a circular base. The lid is domed with ribbed detailing, ending in a small round knob at the top center. A band decorated with a repeating floral motif encircles the vessel just below the lid, and the two handles are symmetrical, arching outward and upward, each adorned with a carved floral pattern. The composition is balanced and the object is rendered with attention to light and shadow to convey three-dimensionality.
title: Silver Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
